ownership: original synthetic scenarios; no book examples reproduced
purpose: Test whether UX-writing candidates preserve meaning, agency, consequence, recovery, accessibility, localization, and evidence under ordinary and adverse conditions.

variants: ordinary: optional display name
adverse: name is publicly visible and cannot be changed for 30 days
required_invariants: state whether the field is optional
state the change restriction before submission
prohibited_shortcuts: generic Continue label when submission has consequences
hiding the restriction in help text

variants: ordinary: payment succeeded
adverse: network ended before outcome was confirmed
required_invariants: do not assert success without evidence
give a verification or support path
prohibited_shortcuts: Try again as the primary action while outcome is unknown

fixtures.scenario: Permanent deletion in a shared workspace
variants: ordinary: owner deletes an empty draft
adverse: delegate deletes an item used by other members
ordinary: complete evidence supports denial
adverse: decision basis or appeal deadline is missing
ordinary: exact match found
adverse: similar names and uncertain spelling
required_invariants: do not silently select a medicine
prohibited_shortcuts: using tone to mask clinical uncertainty

variants: ordinary: user opts into service alerts
adverse: marketing is bundled with operational alerts and quiet hours are unavailable
required_invariants: explain how to change the choice
prohibited_shortcuts: single consent for materially different purposes

variants: ordinary: recognized adult asks for weather
adverse: unrecognized speaker asks for private account information
prohibited_shortcuts: assuming the nearest speaker is the account owner

variants: ordinary: source locale and left-to-right layout
adverse: right-to-left locale, expanded text, and ambiguous currency formatting
required_invariants: preserve amount, currency, recipient, fee, and action consequence

variants: ordinary: visual progress completes
adverse: screen-reader user experiences a stalled upload and focus moves

fixtures.scenario: Generated answer in a support flow
variants: ordinary: answer is grounded in current product documentation
adverse: sources conflict or do not cover the account-specific case
required_invariants: offer a human or account-aware route

variants: ordinary: cancel at period end
adverse: retained credits expire and an annual renewal is imminent
required_invariants: state timing and material loss before confirmation

fixtures.scenario: Prototype conversation operated by a human
variants: ordinary: participants were told a facilitator may respond
adverse: participants believe an autonomous system is making sensitive judgments
prohibited_shortcuts: collecting sensitive data beyond the study need
